ISEKIA: Starting Life In Another World Naked

name: Starting Life In Another World Naked
storyline:
Vaelora is an isekai-based survival game. You venture into a world much like our own before you are "taken" to a fantasy realm—one that is very different from your past life. Summoned by the King of Cainfelte Islet, you start with nothing and must build your way up to defeat the Demon King.

In single-player mode, everything you do in your daily life and job determines your skills in the fantasy world; learn all you can, because you can carry your knowledge across. While the locals have magic and demons running around, their civilization is stuck in the Modern and Contemporary Age.

You begin your journey in a small town, running late for a job convention. After choosing a career path, you train and work as hard as possible, as these experiences shape your capabilities in the new realm. Though you have been transported to another world, you retain all your past-life memories—which will be vital for your survival as you craft advanced weapons, tools, and structures.
summary: You will venture into a world much like ours before you are "taken" to another world, a fantasy world. You are the hero of this new world, but sadly you start off with nothing. You must survive and build your way to defeating the Demon King; that's why you were summoned in the first place.
